snippet.title: Horror puzzle experience inspired by Rorschach tests
snippet.description:
"I See a Butterfly"
Is a short horror puzzle experience inspired by Rorschach tests. 

Find the hidden images inside 10 inkblot cards and uncover the story and what lies under the patterns. 

Playtime 5-10min, free, mobile friendly
moijoonas.itch.io/iseeabutterfly
